per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: KCM21 identity is source-verified from primary XML/PDF. Most linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows are source-supported with condition-specific caveats; source_record_id 58554 is preserved as source_conflict because the local source does not support the database MBC 30 uM value.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered MIC/MBC rows from primary text and Fig. 1-Fig. 3. Rows include endpoint, value, unit, target species/strain, assay conditions, and source locators; no toxicity/hemolysis assay is reported for KCM21 in this paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 preserves mechanism as phenotype/inference level: cation antagonism, rapid bactericidal kinetics, and TEM/SEM morphology support membrane/cell-envelope involvement but not a unique molecular target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The database row for MBC 30 uM remains source_conflict because local primary text/Fig. 1 support C. michiganensis LB MBC 18.8 uM and divalent-cation MBC increase to 25 uM, not 30 uM.
Source-supported cation/glycerol/time-course values are condition-specific; linked database rows omit those condition dimensions.
The final activity file records text-supported exact values and database-linked figure values; it does not invent exhaustive unlabeled bar values from figures beyond locally supported rows.
Packet supplementary indexes and local landing assets show no structured supplementary tables; the source review is bounded to XML/PDF/OA figures/database rows.
The paper supports rapid killing, cation sensitivity, and EM morphology; it does not establish one unique molecular target.
